info.name: NEC - Training Trainee Allocation API

request.description:
Creates a new training trainee allocation.

Returns HTTP 201 on success.

Request body fields:
- traineeId: Long (required)
- trainingClassId: Long (required)
- allocationDate: LocalDate (required) — format: YYYY-MM-DD
- statusId: Long (required)
- notes: String (optional, max 1000 chars)
- createdBy: String
- updatedBy: String

Updates an existing training trainee allocation by its allocation code.

Path variable:
- allocationCode: String (e.g. TA-001)

Returns HTTP 200 on success.

Fetches a single training trainee allocation by its allocation code.

Path variable:
- allocationCode: String (e.g. TA-001)

Returns HTTP 200 on success.

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of training trainee allocations with optional filters.

Query params:
- page: int (default 0)
- size: int (default 10)

Request body (all fields optional — send {} or null to get all):
- allocationCode: String
- traineeId: Long
- universityId: Long
- regionId: Long
- trainingClassId: Long
- trainingTypeId: Long
- statusId: Long
- isActive: Boolean

Activates or deactivates a training trainee allocation.

Path variable:
- allocationCode: String (e.g. TA-001)

Query param:
- isActive: Boolean (required) — true to activate, false to deactivate

Returns HTTP 200 on success.
